insights.subtitle: Simulated summary of aggregated, fictitious responses
insights.empty: No responses have been aggregated yet, so there is nothing for the simulated analysis to summarize. Insights will appear once votes come in.
insights.tie: Based on the {count, plural, one {# aggregated response} other {# aggregated responses}}, the simulated consensus is split evenly between {leaders}, each with {share}% of the vote. The distribution suggests there is no clear favorite yet, so a few more responses could decide the outcome.

insights.unanimous: The distribution suggests complete agreement, as no other option has received a vote.
insights.lowSample: With so few responses, treat this as an early signal.
